equipment_models_catalog_code_unique.name: equipment_models_catalog_code_unique
equipment_models_catalog_code_unique.where: "equipment_models"."code" IS NOT NULL AND "equipment_models"."code" <> '' AND "equipment_models"."owner_user_id" IS NULL

imported_workouts_date_range.name: imported_workouts_date_range
imported_workouts_date_range.value: "imported_workouts"."earliest_date" IS NULL OR "imported_workouts"."latest_date" IS NULL OR "imported_workouts"."earliest_date" <= "imported_workouts"."latest_date"

pain_events_parent_required_check.name: pain_events_parent_required_check
pain_events_parent_required_check.value:
"pain_events"."session_id" IS NOT NULL
          OR "pain_events"."set_id" IS NOT NULL
          OR "pain_events"."exercise_id" IS NOT NULL

prescribed_sets_reps_range_check.name: prescribed_sets_reps_range_check
prescribed_sets_reps_range_check.value:
"prescribed_sets"."target_reps_min" IS NULL OR "prescribed_sets"."target_reps_max" IS NULL
          OR "prescribed_sets"."target_reps_min" <= "prescribed_sets"."target_reps_max"

prescribed_sets_rest_range_check.name: prescribed_sets_rest_range_check
prescribed_sets_rest_range_check.value:
"prescribed_sets"."rest_seconds_min" IS NULL OR "prescribed_sets"."rest_seconds_max" IS NULL
          OR "prescribed_sets"."rest_seconds_min" <= "prescribed_sets"."rest_seconds_max"

sessions_one_open_per_day.name: sessions_one_open_per_day
sessions_one_open_per_day.where: ended_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

sets_prescribed_reps_range_check.name: sets_prescribed_reps_range_check
sets_prescribed_reps_range_check.value:
"sets"."prescribed_reps_min" IS NULL OR "sets"."prescribed_reps_max" IS NULL
          OR "sets"."prescribed_reps_min" <= "sets"."prescribed_reps_max"
